floorPlans.label: Emaar: Palace Residences Hillside full floor plans
floorPlans.introduction: Explore the one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments and the three-bedroom townhouse. Complete sheets preserve unit-group tables, room drawings, key plans and original notices; the townhouse layout shows both levels together.
floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a Palace Hillside apartment or townhouse layout
floorPlans.note: Total area includes balcony or terrace space. Multiple unit-group totals appear as a range. The one-bedroom Type A2 sheet prints 770.12 sq ft, while its 609.88 + 160.31 components sum to 770.19 sq ft; confirm the signed unit area with Emaar. These are Palace Residences Hillside plans, not the separate Hillside B release. Request the selected unit’s contractual plan and specifications.
